facts.claim: Le Dumont-d'Urville (Ponant): Entered service 2019; 37,000 GT; 184 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 217 m length; Explorer class.
Le Dumont-d'Urville is the fourth ship of the Ponant Explorers class of cruise ships operated by Ponant.
However, before entering service she was renamed Le Dumont-d'Urville, after Jules Dumont d'Urville, another explorer and naval officer.
